newsitem.title: USA: Genesis Safety agrees to buy Oil Baltija.
newsitem.headline: Genesis Safety agrees to buy Oil Baltija.

text.p: Genesis Safety Systems Inc said on Monday it entered into an agreement to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Oil Baltija Group Ltd for 22.5 million shares of its common stock.
In connection with the agreement, Genesis agreed to amend its certificate of incorporation to change its name to Oil Baltija Group Ltd, and declare a 1-to-10 reverse split on January 22.
In addition, the company would transfer and assign all of its assets and liabilities to a newly organized corporation.

Oil Baltija Group, a British Virgin Islands corporation owns all of the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of LUKoil Baltija, a crude oil and oil product trading and retail company in the Baltic states.
